author: riverlijunjie
title: GPU build fails: xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, xe3p_unknown are not members of cldnn::gpu_arch
signature: xe3p_35_10 is not a member of cldnn gpu_arch|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Compilation error: xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, xe3p_unknown not members of cldnn::gpu_arch enum

key_errors: moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp:29:20: error: 'xe3p_35_10' is not a member of 'cldnn::gpu_arch'
moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp:30:20: error: 'xe3p_35_11' is not a member of 'cldnn::gpu_arch'
moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp:31:20: error: 'xe3p_unknown' is not a member of 'cldnn::gpu_arch'
root_cause: PR #35433 modified moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp to reference three new gpu_arch enum values (xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, xe3p_unknown) in a switch statement, but failed to add these values to the cldnn::gpu_arch enum definition. The enum is defined elsewhere in the GPU plugin codebase and was not updated as part of this PR, causing a deterministic compilation failure.
reproduction_steps: Build the GPU plugin targeting the modified file: cmake --build openvino_build -- openvino_intel_gpu_ocl_v2_obj
recommended_actions: Add xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, and xe3p_unknown to the cldnn::gpu_arch enum definition
Alternatively, remove the new case statements from moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp if those arch variants are not yet needed
Ensure the enum definition file and the usage file are updated in the same PR
prevention_strategies: When adding new GPU architecture enum values, always update both the enum definition and all switch statements that reference gpu_arch in the same PR. Consider adding a static_assert or compile-time check that catches missing enum values.
historical_context: No prior occurrence of this specific failure pattern in the database.
